content: ESP32-S3 supports fixed USB Serial/JTAG CDC and programmable USB OTG/TinyUSB plus 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. For a permanently USB-powered Linux companion, native CDC is lowest configuration/security complexity and is directly enabled by the official board config. Wi-Fi adds provisioning, addressing and LAN security; hybrid adds two reconnection/state paths and should be deferred unless physical USB data reliability fails.
